transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

My doctor was concerned because she says I’ve gotten too thin. I’ve noticed it too—my work pants are hanging loose on me. But… if I’m being honest, part of me still feels relieved when the number on the scale goes down.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. I am. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I get scared the rest of the day that it’s going to show on me. I keep checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it somehow.
Do you often limit yourself to certain foods or avoid certain foods altogether?

Yes… I do. I’ll cook a full plate for my husband and my mother-in-law, but when it’s time for me to eat, I usually tell myself coffee is enough, or maybe just some vegetables. Sometimes I’ll have half a piece of toast and stop there.
Do you think you are currently at a healthy weight?
I guess... no, probably not. My doctor says I’ve gotten too thin, and I can see my work pants are really loose now. But it’s hard, because part of me still feels relieved when the scale is lower.
Do you think you look fat or overweight even when others say you are too thin?

Yes… even when people say I’m too thin, I don’t always see it that way. If I look small and neat, I feel like I’m doing okay. But if my stomach looks even a little full in the mirror, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No… I don’t make myself vomit after eating. I just usually try not to eat much in the first place.
Do you think your weight or body shape affects how you feel about yourself as a person?

Yes. I think it does, more than I like to admit. When I stay small and neat, I feel like I’m handling things right. But if my stomach looks even a little full in the mirror, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Do you think your weight is the most important aspect of your appearance?
Yes… I think it is, or close to it. If I look small and neat, I feel like I’m doing alright. But if my stomach looks even a little full, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Do you often skip meals altogether?

Yes… I do. I’ll make food for my husband and my mother-in-law, full plates, but when it’s my turn to sit down, I usually tell myself coffee is enough, or maybe a few vegetables. Sometimes just half a piece of toast.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past few months?
Yes. My doctor told me I’ve gotten too thin, and I can see it in my work pants—they hang loose on me now. But… when the number on the scale is lower, part of me still feels relieved.
Do you see yourself as overweight even when you look in the mirror and others tell you that you are too thin?

Yes… even when people say I’m too thin, I don’t really see it that way. If I look small and neat, I feel like I’m managing things. But if my stomach looks even a little full in the mirror, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Do you think your weight is normal when others tell you that you are underweight?

I guess… I don’t really think of myself as underweight. When I stay small and neat, it feels like I’m handling things right. But if my stomach looks even a little full in the mirror, I feel like I’ve let myself go.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most people would eat in a similar time period?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can’t remember eating what I’d call a really large amount all at once. If anything, I’m usually pretty careful about how much I eat.
Do you restrict your food intake because you are afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. If I eat something heavier, like biscuits or pasta, I worry the rest of the day that it’s going to show on me. I keep checking myself, and I start thinking I need to make up for it somehow.
Do you feel guilty after eating?

Yes, I do. Especially if I eat something heavy, like biscuits or pasta. I spend the rest of the day feeling bad and worrying it’s going to show on me, and I keep checking myself and thinking I need to make up for it somehow.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time?
No, not really. I can’t think of times where I eat a big amount quickly like that. I’m usually more focused on keeping portions small.
Have you ever had a period where you gained a lot of weight?
I don’t think so. I can’t really remember a time where I gained a lot of weight all at once.
Do you ever feel like you've lost control while eating?
I’m not sure I’d say I lose control. It’s more that I’m usually very aware of what I’m eating, maybe too aware. I don’t really have times where I feel like I can’t stop.
Has your fear of gaining weight led to significant weight loss over time?

Yes… I think it has. I get really scared after eating something heavier, like biscuits or pasta. Then I spend the rest of the day checking myself and worrying it’s going to show on me, and I feel like I have to make up for it somehow.
